alerts.headline: Flood Warning issued September 29 at 1:06AM EDT until September 30 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: ...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Massachusetts... Taunton River Near Bridgewater affecting Bristol and Plymouth Counties. For the Taunton River...including Bridgewater...Minor flooding is forecast. * WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast. * WHERE...Taunton River near Bridgewater. * WHEN...Until late tonight. * IMPACTS...At 9.0 feet…
alerts.instruction: Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars through flooded areas. Additional information is available at www.weather.gov. The next statement will be issued this afternoon at 300 PM EDT.
